_doc: Goods hung from the store's beaded ceiling (#1182 G3, bolder in #1192 G4): four pairs of pull-on boots tied by their straps along a bar, hung at two heights. A prop that hangs by a hook (GlassProp, as the hanging lamp: it swings when pushed, and falls whole if the board it hangs from goes; its parts never shatter).
